Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for sending the SOW. Welcome aboard!

Short answer: Finance prefers POs, but we do have a formal exception path for time-limited pilots. To evaluate we need:
- Confirmed pilot total (estimate or firm)
- Vendor legal name + tax ID / W-9 (or local equivalent)
- Signed exception form (one page) and the SOW you sent

If the pilot stays under $20k we can usually approve a one-time no-PO invoice flow with Finance sign-off. Laura — can you confirm the cap and required artifact list?

Marissa — FYI this is the HydraCloud pilot (RDW-5532) you negotiated. If we grant an exception we'd like monthly invoices rather than a single lump-sum, if that aligns with their billing.

Next steps for Marta: please share vendor tax info and, if OK, sign the attached exception template and return. I can shepherd approvals once we have docs.

Best,
Ava Chen
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Hi all — finance here. We can process a one-time PO exception for pilot engagements under the following conditions:

1) Total pilot invoice amount does not exceed $20,000 USD.
2) Customer returns a signed procurement exception form (attached).
3) We receive vendor tax documentation (W-9 / local tax id).
4) Invoices are net-30 and sent to accounts-payable@redwood.com; monthly invoices are preferred.
5) Exception approvals must be recorded in our internal procurement system; Ava, I'll need the deal ID (RDW-5532) and the DocuSign/DocSend link to the SOW for audit.

If these are met, I will route for a formal exception sign-off and notify AP to accept invoices without a PO for this engagement only. Note: this is a one-off exception (no precedent).

Attaching: procurement_exception_signed_template.pdf (please sign and return)

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
